value.rationale: A two-dimensional natural parabolic toral transformation is a model of a zero-entropy stationary binary process. The full exact four-consecutive-word law identifies a unique phase transition at distance 1/6, sharp fourth-order correlations between -1/3 and 1/3, and isolated irrational phases at which the four-word law is exactly Bernoulli despite zero entropy. These are nontrivial structural invariants of the coding, not a trivial low-order type check, a variant of an earlier census, or merely a finite computation. The contrast between arbitrarily separated three-wise independence and phase-sensitive four-block independence is mathematically motivated and potentially informative in symbolic-measure constructions.
